_doc: Manual fixes applied by scripts/extract/extract_pdf.py after extracting the PDF. nameAliases: PDF spelling -> canonical name (same YouTube video, pure naming variant). textReplacements: literal substitutions applied to every notes cell (safety net for PDF glyph/spacing artifacts). cells: per-cell overrides keyed by PDF page and 1-based row position (field = name|technique|warmup|sets|reps|early_rpe|last_rpe|rest|sub1|sub2|notes). Note overflow between consecutive rows (block 2 Full Body #2: Standing Calf Raise -> Slow-Eccentric DB RDL) is repaired automatically and checked against expectedNoteOverflows.
